name: codestyles
description: Coding style guides exposed as skills, plus two advisory hooks. Ships generic-style (language-agnostic: side-effect separation, immutability, error handling, logging, naming, testing, types, complexity) and python-style, which builds on it with Python idioms. A PreToolUse hook reminds Claude to apply the matching {language}-style skill, falling back to generic-style; a PostToolUse hook reviews comment style in the code it just wrote.
